rows.note: Use this for the ordinary act of eating, the most common everyday sense.
Use this as the everyday all-purpose expression when something is used up completely.

example.english: We consume a whole roll of toilet paper in a day.
example.traditional: 我哋一日用晒一卷廁紙。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 jat6 jung6 saai3 jat1 gyun2 ci3 zi2

rows.note: Use this for taking in and absorbing information or media content rather than physically eating it.

example.english: I consume a lot of information from the news every day.
example.traditional: 我每日睇新聞，吸收好多資訊。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 tai2 san1 man4 kap1 sau1 hou2 do1 zi1 seon3

rows.note: Use this when something is completely destroyed by burning or fire.

example.english: A major fire can consume an entire factory.
example.traditional: 大火可以將成間工場燒晒。
example.jyutping: daai6 fo2 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 seng4 gaan1 gung1 coeng2 siu1 saai3
